protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. The unauthenticated wp_ajax_nopriv_eael_product_quickview_popup action accepts attacker-controlled product_id after only a frontend nonce check, loads the WooCommerce product, and renders quick-view HTML without catalog-visibility or post-status authorization. The official CVE record is PUBLISHED and describes disclosure of draft, pending, or private product data through this handler.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed b31258ac7a92efdad52a4c5a0820e404facb1473. This single-parent commit first adds both the nopriv hook and the handler that passes wc_get_product(product_id) to the quick-view renderer without an authorization gate; it is a surviving commit in the member branch and later release ancestry.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. Immediate parent 2ff6c909c8bd85373dc1f785f88b1bdab9993140 exists with tree d38e935b4f8a2e664cf99b138e14caf66a9ce195 and contains neither eael_product_quickview_popup nor wp_ajax_eael_product_quickview_popup in PHP or JavaScript.

The later large single-parent b133dda0aca3ee8c7d7757f7fed8633219b544d2 aggregate is therefore not substituted as the BIC; f6605d3669bb5df94849db4bc4e33cbff121848f is a rename and 88bf8b01ebc4867f85312148e3f49f743b50732d/fe82e58022d28999402138be2b19f054999161df are trait extraction/moves.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed. b31258ac7a92efdad52a4c5a0820e404facb1473 is an ancestor of v6.5.5. That tag retains the nopriv hook and the handler at includes/Traits/Ajax_Handler.php:820-842 without is_visible(), edit_post, or publish-status rejection. The official CVE affected range is 0 through 6.5.5.

protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix 4e43db06bcf12870cc3b185ed59b3fe2cd227945 against parent 014572c89b8476537d28c0e5eca2b547a8642dab.
